replicate_statements: The amounts of GTP‐bound Rac1 and Cdc42 in polyps of ApcMin/+ and Asef−/−Asef2−/−ApcMin/+ mice.
GTP‐bound GTPases were precipitated using GST–PAK CRIB coupled to glutathione–Sepharose beads and detected by immunoblotting with the indicated antibodies (for Rac1 and Cdc42).
outputs.explanation: The bar chart quantifying GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 shows error bars implying replicated measurements, but the legend gives no n-number or description of the replicate type (e.g., number of independent pulldown experiments or animals).
